headline: A GTA 6 fan may have tracked down the real-life Miami building that inspired Lucia’s home.
body: A GTA 6 fan may have tracked down the real-life Miami building that inspired Lucia’s home. The location is believed to be the former Belmar Condominium, a Miami property that was reportedly purchased for around $12 million in 2022 before being demolished. Fans noticed similarities between the building’s design and the apartment seen in GTA 6, leading to speculation that Rockstar may have used it as a reference while creating Lucia’s home.
